document: Versioned labour institution and unit contract for HIST_VNEXT H5D (M3). It fixes the meaning of nominal labour, establishment, headcount, absence, effective hours and the household time axes, plus the hire/release rules a future adapter must implement. It is a declared synthetic contract: no historical series is admitted, no parameter is calibrated, and nothing here changes engine behaviour. The reference run keeps its legacy behaviour because this file is not read by the engine.

authorization.utterance: 我授权你编制该 spec 并取独立 PASS
authorization.scope: spec authorship and independent acceptance only

covers: nominal labour to persons-hours unit conversion
exclusivity with the H5B household time budget
does_not_cover: magnitude of labour hoarding in any historical period
historical identification of hours or absence

not_covered: wholesale and retail: capacity 0, nominal labour 1700 WE-q, no establishment or headcount
coverage_boundary.consequence: sum_i E_i covers 15300 WE-q of productive nominal labour; the 1700 WE-q distribution share is reported separately and never enters hours_supplied
coverage_boundary.must_not: silently drop the distribution share or attribute it to productive establishments

unit_contract.why_520: 520 is the real TimeParameters.formal_hours_per_worker default (40 h/week * 13 weeks). The spec adopts it instead of inventing a second conversion; no historical value is claimed.

state_declarations.meaning: nominal labour stock held by a productive organization
state_declarations.producer_required: unchanged (this spec only fixes its meaning)

state_declarations.meaning: establishment: budgeted positions, filled or not
actual headcount present at the end of the quarter
absence rate applied to contracted hours
effort intensity on hours actually attended
effective labour hours available to production

state_declarations.producer_today: recomputed every tick as TimeParameters.formal_hours_per_worker * household_working_adults; no stored field

state_declarations.meaning: queueing hours forced by affordable-but-unavailable goods
search hours forced by channel shortages

state_declarations.producer_today: initialize_material, then updated when investment completes (material.py)
material production phase; rebuilt every tick
material target phase; rebuilt every tick

establishment.target_rule: E_i_raw = capacity_i * labor_per_activity_i * target_utilization_i; E_i = E_i_raw * min(1, N_working / sum_j E_j_raw)
establishment.why_labor_per_activity: capacity is in activity units, not persons; multiplying by labor_per_activity is the unit bridge. Without it the raw sum is 390000 'persons' = 22.94 * N_equivalent_persons and violates identity I3.
establishment.pro_rata_rule: if the raw sum exceeds N_working, scale every organization by the same factor; the rule is order-free so no organization is privileged by iteration order
establishment.note: capacity-linked, not output-linked: a plan cannot infer establishment from realized output, or hoarding becomes unfalsifiable.
establishment.target_utilization_source: MaterialParameters.utilization (0.9); binding to the same constant the engine uses in min(utilization * capacity * season, L_WE / labor_per_activity) avoids a second, invented utilization notion

hire.rule: H1_i = H_i(t-1) - H_i_release(t); H_i(t) = H1_i + scale(t) * H_i_hire_raw(t)
hire.hire_component: H_i_hire_raw(t) = clip(E_i(t) - H1_i, 0, hire_capacity_i) with hire_capacity_i = hire_capacity_share_per_quarter * E_i(t-1)
hire.supply_scale: scale(t) = min(1, avail(t) / sum_i H_i_hire_raw(t)) when the raw sum exceeds avail(t), else 1
hire.ordering: release first (its cap applies to H_i(t-1)), then one order-independent allocation of the remaining external workers across all organizations; no organization is served first
hire.invariant: sum_i H_i(t) <= N_working for every t, by construction of the scale factor

release.rule: H_i_release(t) = clip(H_i(t-1) - E_i(t), 0, max_release_fraction_per_quarter * H_i(t-1)); applied before hiring and capped, so headcount may stay above a falling establishment
release.note: release is capped and lagged; instantaneous full adjustment is forbidden because it would erase hoarding by construction.
release.ordering: applied first in the quarter transition

absence.absence_adjustment_i: declared exogenous path per organization; zero in the reference run

effort.rule: e_i(t) = clip(1 - effort_grievance_weight * grievance_i - effort_informal_hours_weight * informal_hours_share_i - effort_queue_search_weight * queue_search_share_i, effort_floor, 1)
effort.grievance_i: weight-weighted mean of state.household_grievance over the organization's region
effort.informal_hours_share_i: (h_plot + h_second) / (1040 * N_working) for the organization's region
effort.queue_search_share_i: (h_queue + h_search) / (1040 * N_working) for the organization's region

identities.name: time_parameter_decomposition
identities.meaning: per worker-quarter endowment decomposed into formal, plot cap, second-economy cap and the headroom shared by queue, search and leisure

identities.name: household_time_exclusivity
identities.statement: h_formal + h_plot + h_second + h_queue + h_search + h_leisure = 1040 * N_working, with h_leisure = leftover - h_queue - h_search and leftover = max(1040 * N_working - reserved, 0)
identities.enforced_by: hsm_lab.engine.accounting: the household_time_endowment identity compares the six-axis sum with time_endowment_hours * working every quarter

identities.name: effective_hours
identities.note: absence multiplies attended hours; effort multiplies attended-and-present hours; neither may be folded into the other

identities.name: labor_supply_ceiling
identities.statement: sum_i E_i <= N_working and sum_i H_i <= N_working
identities.note: establishment and headcount are both bounded by the working-age population, not by the all-person equivalent count

identities.name: activity_capacity_ceiling
identities.binding_side: at initialization the productive branch has L_WE_i = 1.2 * capacity_i * labor_per_activity_i, so L_WE_i > H_eff_i/520 and effective hours bind first. Capacity grows when investment completes, so the binding side must be re-evaluated from live capacity rather than assumed; the declared rule keeps the min() so either side can bind.
identities.note: nominal labour is the accounting stock; effective hours are the production input. Until the adapter exists the engine still bounds activity by L_WE / labor_per_activity, so the H_eff side is a declared requirement, not an observed behaviour.

identities.name: nominal_labor_productive_aggregate
identities.note: productive branch only; 1.2 headroom cancels the 1.2 denominator

identities.name: nominal_labor_all_organization_aggregate

measured_c0_tick0.note: productive 15300 + distribution 1700 = 17000; the distribution branch has capacity 0 and therefore no establishment, which is a declared coverage boundary, not an omission

identities.note: the distribution branch is not zero; an earlier draft wrongly stated 0.9 for the all-organization sum

identities.name: wage_bill_base
identities.note: this is the only place money touches labour; it must never be used to infer hours

identities.name: headcount_evolution
identities.statement: H_i(t) = H_i(t-1) + H_i_hire(t) - H_i_release(t), with H_i(0) <= E_i(0)
identities.note: release must be subtracted here; without this identity release is declared but inert

identities.name: supply_feasible_transition
identities.statement: sum_i H_i(t) = sum_i H1_i + min(sum_i H_i_hire_raw(t), N_working - sum_i H1_i) <= N_working, with H1_i = H_i(t-1) - H_i_release(t)
identities.witness: N_working=100, E_prev=H_prev=[10,90], E_cur=[1,99]: release [1,0], raw hire [0,9], avail 1, scale 1/9, H=[9,91], sum 100
identities.note: without the scale the witness gives sum H = 108 and violates I3

reconciliation.why: N_equivalent_persons counts every person weighted by household weight; N_working counts unweighted working-age adults, which is what the engine multiplies by formal_hours_per_worker. The two also differ by 80 persons because N_equivalent is weighted and N_working is not.
reconciliation.required_adapter_rule: introduce an explicit unallocated_labor slack term and report it every quarter; never absorb the gap through wages, prices or capacity
forbidden: scaling organisation labour by a fitted factor

unallocated_labor.meaning: working-age persons not employed by any organization; a person count, not a WE stock
unallocated_labor.why_not_computable: H_i does not exist; L_WE is not headcount

gap_quantity.sign: positive means organization labour exceeds the household formal-hours supply expressed in WE
gap_quantity.reporting: must be reported every quarter alongside U_labor; neither may be forced to zero

nominal_effective_gap.sign: positive means nominal labour exceeds effective hours expressed in WE
nominal_effective_gap.meaning: the distribution 1700 WE-q has no establishment under the declared coverage boundary; the productive 3970 WE-q is nominal labour above the establishment clip. Neither is a hoarding estimate.

quarter_boundary_order: adapter labour update (future): establishment, release, hire from the supply pool, absence, effort
plan_household_time: reserve formal, plot and second-economy hours
production activity targets read L_WE and labor_per_activity
allocate_household_baskets: queue and search scaled to leftover, leisure as residual
timing.adapter_position: before plan_household_time, so the labour state is known when household formal hours are reserved
must_not: rewrite any of the six household time axes
write back household hours from the production side
update labour inside the production phase
stage hires or releases across more than one quarter without recording them

effort_inputs_timing.initial_values: zero at t=0 because no previous quarter exists
effort_inputs_timing.why_lagged: the adapter runs before planning, so current-quarter plot/second/queue/search are not yet formed

call_chain.role: capacity ceiling: activities per unit labour
closes the time budget with queue, search and leisure
tick position: time planned before production
enforces the six-axis exclusivity identity every quarter
distribution branch of nominal labour (0.1 share)

unused_labour_share.name: labour_underutilization
unused_labour_share.definition: two declared shares: an establishment-denominator diagnostic (unrestricted range) and a bounded effective-hours share; neither identifies institutional causation
unused_labour_share.why_520: sum_i(lpa * realized) is already a worker-equivalent total; the hours-per-worker constant converts it to hours, matching both denominators
unused_labour_share.activity_realized_bound: after the adapter: activity_realized_i <= H_eff_i / (520 * labor_per_activity_i), so hours_used <= sum_i H_eff_i. There is no general inequality against establishment hours: retained workers can make sum_i H_eff_i exceed 520 * sum_i E_i. Today the engine bounds activity by L_WE_i / labor_per_activity_i instead, so the bound is a declared requirement, not current behaviour.
unused_labour_share.note: the index must be computable without wages; if a wage-only rule can move it, the definition is wrong
unused_labour_share.why_not_computable: E_i and H_eff_i do not exist yet; hours_used exists only as an implicit activity bound

establishment_unused_share.note: with nonnegative hours_used and a positive establishment denominator, 1 - used/supplied <= 1 always; the share can only turn negative once retained headcount pushes effective hours above establishment hours (the declared release lag). A diagnostic, not the bounded metric.
establishment_unused_share.witness: N=100, E=H=[50,50] then E=[40,40], release [5,5] -> H=[45,45], sum E=80, sum H=90; with A=0, e=1 and a high-season ceiling, the share is -0.125

underutilization_share.why_bounded: I4 bounds activity by H_eff/(520*lpa), so hours_used <= sum H_eff; the denominator is effective hours, which may exceed establishment hours without breaking the bound
underutilization_share.zero_denominator: UNDEFINED: report null and the raw counts, never a numeric share
underutilization_share.note: a feasible start can have H(0)=0 while E(0)>0, so zero effective hours is admissible; the share is then undefined rather than 0 or 1

institutional_attribution.why: the share mixes utilization, seasonality and input rationing; no counterfactual isolates institutional causes
institutional_attribution.must_not: label the share as evidence of institutional labour hoarding

capacity_denominator_variant.status: NOT the reported metric; recorded only to show that 0.1692 is a denominator artefact

unused_labour_share.pre_clip_note: using the pre-clip capacity labour (12750) as the denominator gives 0.1692; the establishment rule clips first, so 5891600 h and 0.06511 are the consistent values

measured_c0_tick0.derivation: C0 tick 0; capacity labour sum(capacity*labor_per_activity) = 12750; E_raw = 12750 * target_utilization(0.9) = 11475; N_working = sum(working_adults) = 11330; clip = min(1, 11330/11475) = 0.9873638; net per-org factor = 0.9 * clip = 0.8886275; sum E = 11330 (the clip saturates at N_working); hours_used = 520 * 10592.3077; hours_supplied = 11330 * 520; share = 1 - used/supplied. N_gap 5670 assumes H_i = E_i with A_i = 0 and e_i = 1; absence or effort below 1 move it.
measured_c0_tick0.weight_convention: sum(weight * working_adults) = 11250. The engine's formal-hours identity uses the unweighted count, so the spec adopts 11330 and records the 80-person convention gap instead of silently choosing the other convention.
measured_c0_tick0.note: C0 tick 0 has H = E, so establishment and effective hours coincide; this value is an establishment-denominator diagnostic, not a hoarding estimate

negative_controls.requirement: changing wage_rate or wage arrears while holding E_i, H_i, A_i and e_i fixed must leave unused_labour_share unchanged
changing establishment or release rules while holding wages fixed must move unused_labour_share
plot and second-economy hours are subtracted from the household endowment exactly once and are never also subtracted from organization labour

test_matrix.assertion: schema keys present; status DECLARED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; default_off true; wired_into_engine false
all contract_bindings equal the live defaults in hsm_lab.contract
every call_chain anchor exists in its declared file
identity I1b lists exactly the six exclusive time axes
historical UNIDENTIFIED, admitted_series empty, no calibrated parameter
unused_labour_share excludes wage inputs and is not computable today
reconciliation is UNRECONCILED_DECLARED with both sides and an explicit slack
all stop conditions present
establishment, headcount, absence, effective hours and release each have their own key and unit
headcount moves toward establishment by at most max_release_fraction_per_quarter per quarter (notice is an initiation lag, not a completion guarantee); full recovery may take several quarters
test_matrix.witness: H_prev=100, E_cur=80 -> release 10 -> H=90 in one quarter

test_matrix.assertion: hours_used <= sum_i H_eff_i every quarter
legacy C0/C1 digests unchanged with the adapter disabled
identity coverage I1a/I1b/I2/I3/I4/I5a/I5b/I6/I7, summation qualifiers, release in I7
hours_used carries the 520 conversion and excludes any non-labour index term
establishment bridges capacity units by labor_per_activity and never anchors on realized output; hire subtracts release
13 contract bindings, forbidden shortcuts, timing bans, negative controls NOT_RUN, price-index exclusion
U_labor is persons, G_labor is WE-q, capacity/lpa/realized declared
every numeric rule parameter is bound or declared uncalibrated; adapter rule keeps the slack and the ban
I4 and hours_used are bound by H_eff; measured C0 block is arithmetically self-consistent
aggregate formulas keep 0.9/1.0 terms; no calendar year appears in rule text; I2 keeps absence and effort factors
coverage boundary declared (covered branch, two uncovered branches, 1700 WE-q) and N_working/N_equivalent_persons declared
no bare legacy-metric key or prose survives anywhere
rules.establishment.coverage only references scope.coverage_boundary
evidence_scope states tick-0 range, declared-not-observed status, absence of engine re-derivation and the year-scan whitelist; derivation non-empty
no money term outside I6; I6 keeps the wage-bill definition and the hours ban; establishment target_rule applies target_utilization_i
hire/release preserve the supply pool (release first, order-free hire scaling, sum H <= N_working); the adapter runs before plan_household_time; effort inputs are lagged to t-1

historical.note: no labour-hours, absence or establishment series is admitted. Every declared rule is a structural assumption for synthetic experiments, not a description of Hungary or of any other economy.
historical.promotion_rule: a historical claim requires an admitted series plus a separately reviewed identification design

stop_conditions: full migration of legacy state versions is required
the new state changes any default behaviour
wage or arrears substitutes for the hoarding card
declared parameters are presented as calibrated or historical
the two labour totals are asserted to be equal without an explicit slack

declared_parameters.name: rules.establishment.target_utilization
declared_parameters.why: bound to MaterialParameters.utilization so establishment and production share one utilization notion

declared_parameters.name: rules.hire.hire_lag_quarters
declared_parameters.why: hiring takes one quarter; instantaneous staffing would make hoarding unobservable

declared_parameters.name: rules.hire.hire_capacity_share_per_quarter
declared_parameters.why: at most a quarter of the establishment can be hired in one quarter

declared_parameters.name: rules.release.release_notice_quarters
declared_parameters.why: one-quarter notice keeps release slower than hiring, which is what makes hoarding a testable state

declared_parameters.name: rules.release.max_release_fraction_per_quarter
declared_parameters.why: a release cap; without it a single-quarter adjustment erases hoarding by construction

declared_parameters.name: rules.absence.absence_default
declared_parameters.why: the reference run has no absence; absence is an exogenous path, not a fitted value

declared_parameters.name: rules.absence.absence_upper_bound
declared_parameters.why: declared sanity bound so absence cannot silently substitute for release

evidence_scope.measured_block: measured_c0_tick0 is C0 tick 0 only; later ticks include an input-rationing component the two-term slack identity does not model
evidence_scope.pro_forma: the measured numbers instantiate the declared establishment rule; they are not an observed adapter output because E_i/H_eff do not exist yet
evidence_scope.not_gated: no gate re-derives these numbers from the engine; they were produced by an in-process build of historical_f2_replay at seed 1729 and must be recomputed if the engine or the scenario changes
evidence_scope.calendar_year_scan: S18 scans every free-text value for a calendar year or a quarter label; only authorization.date is exempt
evidence_scope.gate_limits: S23 rejects (a) any string that combines a currency term with the hours-per-worker constant or with a division/multiplication by a number, anywhere in the document, (b) any currency mention in a normative section without prohibition wording, and (c) any key added to unit_contract. It does not prove that no future numeric field could encode a currency-per-hour factor; that is why unit_contract keys are closed, conversion_rule is pinned, and a human reviewer reads the prose.
